Definition: from G882; an Achaian; Achaicus, a Christian:--Achaicus.
BiblicalUsage: Achaicus is named once, in Paul's closing greetings, when he came with Stephanas and Fortunatus and his visit supplied what the Corinthian church itself could not.
TheologicalSignificance: There is no great theology in a name on a greeting list. But I believe it still preaches: the encouragement of a faithful brother's presence is real ministry, and Paul was glad for it.
